reviewer: Benchmark author; condition visible; qualitative audit, not independent clinical review
scope: 12 prespecified outputs: four held-out cases at seed 17 across three workflows
summary: The validator materially improved parseability, but over-limit and repeated-card failures remain. The audit is descriptive and does not establish communication benefit.
